messages:
pagerduty-bot: PAGER: INC-2026-2345 — High — multiple NCCL collectives hanging in inference-prod-gpupool-2. Triggered by `ncclCommAbort` and `CUDA_ERROR_ILLEGAL_INSTRUCTION` on several ranks. Affects Dedicated customers on tensor-parallel workloads. Please ack and triage.

mira: acked. I see repeated OOM + `ncclAllReduce` timeouts in the logs from node gpu-ml-112 and gpu-ml-115. Latency spike on model-route /v1/generate (tp=8).

kevin: +1, I'm pulling the node logs. Quick check: are these NVLink/IB errors or CUDA-only?

sam: logs show both: `NCCL WARN Call to connect timed out`, then `ncclCommAbort()`, then container restart. NVLink link 1 reports flaps on gpu-ml-115.

rachel: Customer-facing impact: three Dedicated clusters seeing 5-20% request failures and tail-latency > 10s. Notified Account DS teams.

infra-sre: repro attempt: running a small tp=8 allreduce locally shows hang when one rank gets `cudaMalloc` OOM during warmup. Might be memory fragmentation + kernel mismatch after a recent runtime patch.

mira: mitigation idea: fallback routing to single-GPU variant for affected tenants, and drain any node that has repeated `ncclCommAbort`. Can we trigger Canary fallback?

deploy-bot: Deploy policy check: Canary fallback route exists for these customers (policy id: route-fallback-2026). Manual flip requires ops approval.

kevin: I'm going to cordon gpu-ml-115 and evict pods from gpu-ml-112. Will restart the container runtime after evacuating.

sam: while you cordon, I'll roll our NCCL build back on a staging pool to test whether the recent kernel selection change is the root cause. Need a quick canary.

mira: timeline and actions: 1) Cordon/evict offending nodes (kevin) 2) Flip customer routing to single-gpu variants (mira + ops) 3) Restart container runtime on drained nodes (kevin) 4) Run allreduce regression on staging (sam) 5) If stable, join nodes back / roll forward.

kevin: cordon started on gpu-ml-115. Evicting containers: `kubectl drain gpu-ml-115 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.

infra-sre: note: evict will take ~2m per pod; some pods have large caches, might hit grace period. Consider `--force` if it stalls.

rachel: I sent a short customer advisory to impacted accounts: "We are investigating an intermittent multi-GPU communication issue. Short-term routing changes applied to reduce errors. We'll follow up with root cause and mitigations."

mira: flipping route-fallback-2026 now for the affected customer list. Will monitor error rate.

deploy-bot: ACTION: route-fallback-2026 toggled to ON for tenants [cust-alpha, cust-gamma, cust-zeta] by mira at 1965440150.

sam: staging allreduce repro succeeded when using the old NCCL kernel selection, fails on the new one. Looks like a regression in kernel choice for tp>4.

kevin: containers on gpu-ml-115 restarted cleanly after runtime restart. No `ncclCommAbort` after restart so far. Monitoring.

infra-sre: CPU/IO anomalies observed on gpu-ml-112 prior to hang — possible transient firmware hiccup. Captured dmesg: "GPU link reset detected".

mira: summary: immediate mitigation applied (routing fallback + node evacuations), staging repro discovered kernel-selection regression. Next: coordinate a hotfix, plan a rolling restart of affected pools during low traffic, customer follow-up.

rachel: customer CS notified with ETA for postmortem. Will include timing and mitigation steps.

mira: handing off to morning oncall (kevin) for watch-and-wait; will update this thread with root cause PR and rollback plan. Please keep logs / traces pinned.

kevin: taking handoff. continuing metrics check and will post updates every 10m.

pagerduty-bot: Incident INC-2026-2345 acknowledged by mira at 1965439999. Pager escalations silenced for 30m.

(react: :thumbsup: on mira's mitigation plan)
